# protonpass_passphrase (Ephemeral Resource)

Passphrase ephemeral resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "protonpass_passphrase" "example" {
  separator  = "underscores"
  capitalize = true
  numbers    = true
  word_count = 16
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `capitalize` (Boolean) Whether to capitalize each word in the passphrase
- `numbers` (Boolean) Whether to include numbers in the generated passphrase
- `separator` (String) Which separator to use
- `word_count` (Number) Amount of words in the passphrase

### Read-Only

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Generated passphrase
